title: Sordland/Turn03/Autocrat Post Discussion
description: Discussion after autocrat draft has been selected.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They read the decree and discussed..."
entries.dialogueText: They read the decree and discussed it amongst themselves.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After I made the final changes to t..."
entries.dialogueText: After I made the final changes to the decree, I showed it to them.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Looks like the only thing left is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Looks like the only thing left is to sign and declare the order, sir."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian spoke afterwards."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian spoke afterwards.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""But I am afraid that this will cre..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I am afraid that this will create further problems for our administration."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Especially by declaring the Bludis..."
entries.dialogueText: "Especially by declaring the Bludish separatists a threat, we should expect more violence against Bludish citizens in general."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""What are you worried about? They a..."
entries.dialogueText: "What are you worried about? They are a national security threat."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""We can't allow Bludish people to s..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can't allow Bludish people to support terrorist organizations. They should have known better."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I agree with declaring the Young S..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree with declaring the Young Sords as a threat, especially after the shooting. However, I think we might bring the nationalists wrath upon ourselves."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""I believe Mr. Kibener may have con..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe Mr. Kibener may have connections to that organization."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""Although I have no problems with h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Although I have no problems with him, this should prompt a proper investigation."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian looked at the decree again."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian looked at the decree again.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I agree. Anyone who have any conne..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree. Anyone who have any connections to them should be investigated."
entries.menuText: "I agree. Anyone who have any connections to them should be investigated."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Maybe we can leave Mr. Kibener alo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe we can leave Mr. Kibener alone for now and keep it on the organization level."
entries.menuText: "Maybe we can leave Mr. Kibener alone for now and keep it on the organization level."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian looked at the decree again."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian looked at the decree again.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Mr. President. We have to be caref..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President. We have to be careful with the situation we're creating here."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Our actions against Arcasia will n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our actions against Arcasia will not be received lightly. Angering a superpower will be tough on our economy."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We'll no longer bow to them.""
entries.dialogueText: "We'll no longer bow to them."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We will take the proper precaution..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will take the proper precautions."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I am aware, Lucian.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am aware, Lucian."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Going against United Contana and b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Going against United Contana and banning the Red Youth will definitely make us an enemy of the Contanan Security Pact."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""What's important here is that we'r..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's important here is that we're taking the steps to fight against the communists."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We can't take this lightly.""
entries.dialogueText: "We can't take this lightly."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""But we're also acting against Arca..."
entries.dialogueText: "But we're also acting against Arcasia, Mr. President. We'll need them against the Eastern powers."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""I believe that was a difficult dec..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe that was a difficult decision to make but Sordland stands alone, Mr. Galade, you know that."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""As much as I despise Arcasia and h..."
entries.dialogueText: "As much as I despise Arcasia and have a reason to believe that they're behind all this mess..."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""Mr. President decided not to act a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President decided not to act against them. If things comes to the worst, we'll have their protection, Mr. Galade."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""There's no reason to be afraid of..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's no reason to be afraid of those communists..."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""With the order of this decree, we..."
entries.dialogueText: "With the order of this decree, we would be able to detain anybody who is suspected for a crime."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""I will personally lead an investig..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will personally lead an investigation against Mr. Ricter. As soon as any other leads come up..."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""...We'll be able to get rid of him.""
entries.dialogueText: "...We'll be able to get rid of him."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""Let's instead focus on what we wil..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's instead focus on what we will be doing."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't get carried away, he's not o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't get carried away, he's not our main target."
entries.menuText: "Don't get carried away, he's not our main target."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes, we must focus on the oppositi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, we must focus on the opposition."
entries.menuText: "Yes, we must focus on the opposition."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm looking forward to that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm looking forward to that."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""Whatever you say, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever you say, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""Luckily, the police will have the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Luckily, the police will have the authority to deal with the threats now."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""But I still do not think that the..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I still do not think that the police has the necessary powers to eliminate the threats effectively."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Well, I think suspension of protes..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, I think suspension of protests and gathering of crowds will be very tough on the budget of the police."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""And the people will not like this...."
entries.dialogueText: "And the people will not like this. Especially the reformists."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""I hope the precautions will prove..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope the precautions will prove to be enough."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""That's precisely who we are agains..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's precisely who we are against, Mr. Galade."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""In any case...""
entries.dialogueText: "In any case..."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""What's left to do is to declare th..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's left to do is to declare the emergency and get it accepted in the Supreme Court, sir."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We should plan your speech for the..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should plan your speech for the declaration. This will be a big moment for Sordland."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We all shook hands and they left th..."
entries.dialogueText: We all shook hands and they left the room.

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""I'll be in touch, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll be in touch, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""The Supreme Court will be waiting..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Supreme Court will be waiting for the declaration."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I expect the Court to fulfil their..."
entries.dialogueText: "I expect the Court to fulfil their promise."
entries.menuText: "I expect the Court to fulfil their promise."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Let's get to work gentlemen.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let's get to work gentlemen."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you for all the hard work.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for all the hard work."
entries.menuText: "Thank you for all the hard work."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""A new era begins.""
entries.dialogueText: "A new era begins."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""It seems so.""
entries.dialogueText: "It seems so."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""Of course, Mr. President. We are w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Mr. President. We are working together in this."
